reconciliation: Every individual request reconciles exactly in device, host, and priority-based critical-path views.

observer_effect.expected_from_unprofiled_EXP_0001: graphs enabled are faster on both targets
observer_effect.observed_with_full_trace: graphs enabled are 148% slower than disabled on gfx1100 and 105% slower on gfx1201; gfx1201 also becomes faster than gfx1100
observer_effect.device_only_falsifier: removing HIP API tracing left gfx1100 graph-enabled median at 3371.056 ms versus 3375.628 ms with full tracing
observer_effect.conclusion: kernel-dispatch tracing itself materially serializes or delays HIP graph execution; graph-enabled trace buckets are not representative of production

qualified_graph_disabled_signal: With graphs disabled, profiling preserves the production direction: gfx1201 request median is 101.90 ms higher, GPU-busy union is 40.83 ms higher, and GPU-nonbusy median is 77.99 ms higher. Because these are medians of separate captures they are diagnostic, not an additive causal decomposition.
next_action: Replace graph-enabled rocprofiler timelines with low-overhead in-process graph/API timing and a separately validated GPU-activity mechanism before selecting an optimization.
